verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developer page says Zapier can connect your mail to 5000+ apps and that a direct API exists. That suggests event-driven automation is possible, but no specific trigger events or webhooks are documented. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs to confirm event delivery. Missing for 10: documented webhooks, named Zapier triggers for new-mail and scan-complete events, payload/delivery documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
